svg.text: L_prob: 1.2 × BCE( p_pred, target_mask ) where target_mask[matched]=1
L_unmatched: 1.0 × mean( B_pred[unmatched]² ) — suppress noisy slots
L_sum: 6.0 × SmoothL1( ΣB_pred, ΣB_true ) — total amplitude conservation
L_count: 0.5 × SmoothL1( count_head, N_true ) — cardinality supervision
Total bipartite loss = sum of all 6 terms · The physical spectrum loss (λ=0.3) is added separately
